In
case of an average annual rainfall amount of 235 mm, it was found that the
‘‘catchment-to-cropping ratio’’ (CCR) should be at least 7.4 in order to provide, on
average, a sufﬁcient amount of water for the cultivation of olive trees.
note: Retain crop-specific235mm climate assumption and7.4 ratio as design recommendation, not practice rainfall envelope; upper/lower source comparisons contradictory and runoff-dependent. No generic siting function.
